text: E ɓee fennooɓe yi'aali e ummital, ko woni yeeso maɓɓe imoorde ka leydi, ɓe yi'a ko woni ɓaawo maɓɓe immorde ka kammu? Ɓe anndi si Men muuyuno munnidugol leydi ndin ley koyɗe maɓɓe, Men waɗayno ɗum, e wonnde si Men muuyuno fukkinnde e hoore maɓɓe, taƴontine immorde ka kammu, Men waɗayno ɗum kadi. Wonii e ɗum, maande pellital, wonannde kala jeyaaɗo ɗuuɗuɗo ruttagol e ɗoftaare Joomi mun, dallinoroowo ɗum e kattal Makko. Hattanɗo ɗum On, hino hattani kadi wuurnitugol on ɓaawo maayde mon, e bonnitugol ɓanlli mon.
